hypothesis: Explicitly preserving the fixed 11-activity by 2-wrist structure from pre-fusion wrist embeddings until the decision stage may add discriminative information beyond the frozen STR-01 activity-structured path.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Retain only if BA improves by at least 0.01, AUROC by at least 0.015, Macro-F1 does not decrease, neither class recall is materially sacrificed, about 10 of 15 matched splits improve, all three seeds agree in direction, and seed stability does not materially worsen.
